description: This file contains Redux selectors for managing and retrieving group-related data within the Mattermost application, including functions to get all groups, filter groups, and manage group associations with teams and channels.

methods.name: getGroupInfoForIds
methods.description: Retrieves group objects for a list of group IDs from a set of groups.

methods.name: getAllGroups
methods.description: Returns all groups from the global state.

methods.name: getAllGroupsByName
methods.description: Creates a mapping of group names to group objects.

methods.name: getMyGroupIds
methods.description: Returns the list of group IDs associated with the current user.

methods.name: getAllGroupStats
methods.description: Returns statistics for all groups.

methods.name: getGroupStats
methods.description: Returns statistics for a specific group by ID.

methods.name: getGroup
methods.description: Retrieves a group object by ID.

methods.name: getGroupMemberCount
methods.description: Returns the total member count for a specific group.

methods.name: getGroupSyncables
methods.description: Retrieves syncable entities (teams and channels) for a group.

methods.name: getGroupTeams
methods.description: Returns teams associated with a group.

methods.name: getGroupChannels
methods.description: Returns channels associated with a group.

methods.name: getAllCustomGroups
methods.description: Filters and returns custom groups that are allow_reference, not deleted, and have source as Custom.

methods.name: getGroupsAssociatedToTeamForReference
methods.description: Returns groups associated with a specific team that are allow_reference and not deleted.

methods.name: getAssociatedGroupsForReference
methods.description: Returns groups associated with a team and/or channel, considering constraints.

methods.name: getAssociatedGroupsByName
methods.description: Creates a mapping of group names to group objects for associated groups.

methods.name: getAssociatedGroupsForReferenceByMention
methods.description: Creates a map of mention keys to groups for reference.

methods.name: searchAssociatedGroupsForReferenceLocal
methods.description: Filters associated groups matching a search term locally.

methods.name: getTeamGroupIDSet
methods.description: Creates a set of group IDs associated with a team.

methods.name: getChannelGroupIDSet
methods.description: Creates a set of group IDs associated with a channel.

methods.name: getMyGroups
methods.description: Returns groups associated with the current user, sorted.

methods.name: getGroupsNotAssociatedToTeam
methods.description: Returns groups not associated with a specific team, filtered by syncable source.

methods.name: getGroupsAssociatedToTeam
methods.description: Returns groups associated with a specific team.

methods.name: getGroupsNotAssociatedToChannel
methods.description: Returns groups not associated with a specific channel, considering team constraints.

methods.name: getGroupsAssociatedToChannel
methods.description: Returns groups associated with a specific channel.

methods.name: getGroupsAssociatedToChannelForReference
methods.description: Returns groups associated with a channel that are allow_reference and not deleted.

methods.name: makeGetAllAssociatedGroupsForReference
methods.description: Creates a memoized selector for all associated groups considering locale and archived status.

methods.name: getAllGroupsForReferenceByName
methods.description: Creates a mapping of group names to group objects for all reference groups.

methods.name: makeGetMyAllowReferencedGroups
methods.description: Creates a selector for current user's allowed reference groups, sorted.

methods.name: getMyGroupsAssociatedToChannelForReference
methods.description: Returns current user's groups associated with a channel for reference.

methods.name: getMyGroupMentionKeys
methods.description: Returns mention keys for current user's groups that are allow_reference.

methods.name: getMyGroupMentionKeysForChannel
methods.description: Returns mention keys for user's groups associated with a channel.

methods.name: searchAllowReferencedGroups
methods.description: Filters groups that are allowed for reference matching a search term.

methods.name: searchMyAllowReferencedGroups
methods.description: Filters user's groups that are allowed for reference matching a search term.

methods.name: isMyGroup
methods.description: Checks if a group ID belongs to the current user.

methods.name: getArchivedGroups
methods.description: Returns archived groups (deleted).

methods.name: searchArchivedGroups
methods.description: Filters archived groups matching a search term.
